### The XML specification of a simple SIR model

Note that many default values of XML attributes are omitted. The XML below is annotated with comments between <!--  -->

``` xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<TB.Vx.model.inputfile xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="../../TB-Vx-schema-S.xsd">
  <simulation from.year="2020" thru.year="2021" dt="0.02">
```

**from.year** and **thru.year** specify the start and the end of the simulation run [note that **thru.year** is the final time point i.e. 2021.0 in this case]\
**dt** is the time step for generating output

``` xml
    <options>
      <numerical.integration/>
    </options>
```

see the XML Schema for default values of attributes of the elements above\
default integration algorithm is **ode23** ; see the R deSolve package for details

``` xml
    <demography country.code="ignored" rescale.population="2050">
```

**ignored** means from the command line or passed as an argument to the set.paths() function

``` xml
      <from.data>
        <population file="data/demographics.csv"/>
        <birthrate from.population.data="true"/>
        <mortality file="data/deathrates.csv"/>
      </from.data>
    </demography>
<!--<contact.matrix file="data/all_contacts_2020.txt" />-->
 </simulation>
```

**ISO3/data/demographics.csv** e.g. **ZAF/data/demographics.csv** should contain UNPOP projections i.e. population by single year age groups from 1900 - 2050

**from.population.data** means that the number of newborns will be derived from UNPOP data ; in this model version the value should be **"true"**

**deathrates.csv** contains WHO mortality data and is used to calculate background mortality

If **country.code="ignored"** the country code passed as an argument will be prepended to the file name ; the full path for e.g. ZAF: **ZAF/data/ZAF_deathrates.csv**

If the **contact.matrix** is omitted / commented out age mixing will be proportionate ; the country code will be prepended to file name e.g. **ZAF/data/ZAF_all_contacts_2020.txt**

``` xml
  <output>
   <detailed.output years="2020+(0:50)*0.02" age.group.lower.limits="c(0,15)">
      <flows dim="TB" transmission="true" progression="true"/>
      <flows dim="HIV"/>
      <flows dim="VXa"/>
    </detailed.output>
  </output>
```

**years**="2020+(0:50)\*0.02" means that output will be generated from 2020.0 thru 2021.0 in 0.02 time steps ; all output time points should be in the specified simulation years

**age.group.lower.limits** should be a subset of age groups specified in `<ages>`

(see the XML Schema for additional options for `<detailed.output>` and default values for specifying flows)

``` xml
  <ages lower.limits="5*(0:15)"/>
```

there are two options for **lower.limits** in the `<ages>` element:

-   lower.limits="c(0:80,90)" i.e. single year age groups 0-79, one age group 80-89, one age group 90-99
-   lower.limits="5\*(0:15)" i.e. 5 year age groups 0-4, 5-9, etc and one 75-99 age group

### A simple SIR model specification

``` xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<TB.Vx.model.inputfile xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="../../TB-Vx-schema-Z.xsd">
  <simulation from.year="2020" thru.year="2021" dt="0.02">
```

i.e. run from 2020 thru 2021 with time steps of 0.02 year

``` xml
    <options><numerical.integration/></options>
    <demography country.code="ignored" rescale.population="2050">
      <from.data>
        <population file="data/demographics.csv"/>
        <birthrate from.population.data="true"/>
        <mortality file="data/deathrates.csv"/>
      </from.data>
    </demography>
  </simulation>
  <output>
   <detailed.output years="2020+(0:50)*0.02" age.group.lower.limits="c(0,15)">
      <flows dim="TB" transmission="true" progression="true"/>
      <flows dim="HIV"/>
      <flows dim="VXa"/>
      <flows dim="RISK"/>
    </detailed.output>
  </output>
  <ages lower.limits="5*(0:15)"/>
  <VXa> <VXa.stages> <stage name="NA"/></VXa.stages></VXa>
  <SES> <SES.stages> <stage name="NA"/></SES.stages></SES>
  <RISK><RISK.stages><stage name="NA"/></RISK.stages></RISK>
  <HIV> <HIV.stages> <stage name="NA"/></HIV.stages></HIV>
  <TB>
    <TB.stages>
      <stage name="S" />
      <stage name="I" />
      <stage name="R" />
    </TB.stages>
    <seeded.infections name="multiplier" value="1">
      <seeded.infection fraction="0.01" age.from="0" age.thru="99" stage="I"/>
      <seeded.infection fraction="0.00" age.from="0" age.thru="99" stage="R"/>
    </seeded.infections>
    <TB.progression>
      <TB.parameter name="d" value="7" />
      <transition.matrix>
        <transition from="I" to="R" rate="1/(d/365.2425)" />
      </transition.matrix>
    </TB.progression>
   <TB.infectivity >
      <TB.parameter name="infc" value="1." /> 
      <infectivity.matrix Mtb-strain="drugsens">
        <infectivity stage="I" value="infc" />
      </infectivity.matrix>
    </TB.infectivity>
    <TB.transmission>
    <TB.parameter name="bc" value="0.4" />
      <transmission.matrix Mtb-strain="drugsens">
        <transition from="S" to="I" rate="bc" />
      </transmission.matrix>
    </TB.transmission>
  </TB>
</TB.Vx.model.inputfile>

We will document this example by providing comments within the XML specification.

``` xml
  <VXa> <VXa.stages> <stage name="NA"/></VXa.stages></VXa>
  <SES> <SES.stages> <stage name="NA"/></SES.stages></SES>
  <RISK><RISK.stages><stage name="NA"/></RISK.stages></RISK>
  <HIV> <HIV.stages> <stage name="NA"/></HIV.stages></HIV>
```

The **VXa**, **SES**, **RISK**, and **HIV** dimensions are not used in this example.

``` xml
  <TB>
```

Define the S, I and R stages:

``` xml
    <TB.stages>
      <stage name="S" />
      <stage name="I" />
      <stage name="R" />
    </TB.stages>
```

and start with start with 1% infected in 2020:

``` xml
    <seeded.infections name="multiplier" value="1">
      <seeded.infection fraction="0.01" age.from="0" age.thru="99" stage="I"/>
      <seeded.infection fraction="0.00" age.from="0" age.thru="99" stage="R"/>
    </seeded.infections>
```

-   define TB progression from **I** to **R** i.e. transitions independent of transmission
-   define parameter **d** i.e. duration of the **I** stage which is 7 days
-   define the rate of the transition from **I** to **R** as 1/(**d**/365.2425)
-   all rates have the unit 1/year ; one year is defined as 365.2425 days

``` xml
    <TB.progression>
      <TB.parameter name="d" value="7" />
      <transition.matrix>
        <transition from="I" to="R" rate="1/(d/365.2425)" />
      </transition.matrix>
    </TB.progression>
```

-   define the infectivity of **I** to be 1.0

``` xml
   <TB.infectivity>
      <TB.parameter name="infc" value="1." /> 
      <infectivity.matrix>
        <infectivity stage="I" value="infc" />
      </infectivity.matrix>
    </TB.infectivity>
```

-   the parameter **bc** is the product of transmission probability per contact and contact rate
-   note that the contact rate is per day as polymod matrices have contacts per day and internally the contact rate is multiplied with 365.2425 days/year to be consistent with year as the time unit
-   the **R0** equals **bc** \* 365.2425 \* **d** / 365.2425 = **bc** \* **d**

``` xml
    <TB.transmission>
    <TB.parameter name="bc" value="0.4" />
      <transition.matrix>
        <transition from="S" to="I" rate="bc" />
      </transition.matrix>
    </TB.transmission>
  </TB>
</TB.Vx.model.inputfile>
```

The complete XML without comments / documentation:

``` xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<TB.Vx.model.inputfile xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="../../TB-Vx-schema-S.xsd">
  <simulation from.year="2020" thru.year="2021" dt="0.02">
    <options>
      <numerical.integration/>
      <exceptional.conditions/>
    </options>
    <demography country.code="ignored" rescale.population="2050">
      <from.data>
        <population file="data/demographics.csv"/>
        <birthrate from.population.data="true"/>
        <mortality file="data/deathrates.csv"/>
      </from.data>
    </demography>
  </simulation>
  <output>
   <detailed.output years="2020+(0:50)*0.02" age.group.lower.limits="c(0,15)">
      <flows dim="TB" transmission="true" progression="true"/>
      <flows dim="HIV"/>
      <flows dim="VXa"/>
    </detailed.output>
  </output>
  <ages lower.limits="5*(0:15)"/>
  <VXa> <VXa.stages> <stage name="NA"/></VXa.stages></VXa>
  <SES> <SES.stages> <stage name="NA"/></SES.stages></SES>
  <RISK><RISK.stages><stage name="NA"/></RISK.stages></RISK>
  <HIV> <HIV.stages> <stage name="NA"/></HIV.stages></HIV>
  <TB>
    <TB.stages>
      <stage name="S" />
      <stage name="I" />
      <stage name="R" />
    </TB.stages>
    <seeded.infections name="multiplier" value="1">
      <seeded.infection fraction="0.01" age.from="0" age.thru="99" stage="I"/>
      <seeded.infection fraction="0.00" age.from="0" age.thru="99" stage="R"/>
    </seeded.infections>
    <TB.progression>
      <TB.parameter name="d" value="7" />
      <transition.matrix>
        <transition from="I" to="R" rate="1/(d/365.2425)" />
      </transition.matrix>
    </TB.progression>
   <TB.infectivity>
      <TB.parameter name="infc" value="1." /> 
      <infectivity.matrix>
        <infectivity stage="I" value="infc" />
      </infectivity.matrix>
    </TB.infectivity>
    <TB.transmission>
    <TB.parameter name="bc" value="0.4" />
      <transition.matrix>
        <transition from="S" to="I" rate="bc" />
      </transition.matrix>
    </TB.transmission>
  </TB>
</TB.Vx.model.inputfile>
```
